description: ZIL Limited is a Pakistani soap and personal-care manufacturer. The business began in 1954 with a skin-cleansing soap range, made at a factory in Hyderabad, and grew from there; it was converted into a public limited company in November 1986 (the name Zulfeqar Industries Ltd. dates from 1980) and listed on the Karachi and Lahore stock exchanges. Its brands today are built around Capri soaps and hand wash, HYPRO antibacterial soap, Opal soap and the HYPE body spray. Head office is in Karachi, with sales and distribution across the country.
